elements.name: subtitle
elements.text: Prefer documented components with a clear failure path; qualify the remaining AI4R-specific behavior.

elements.name: source
elements.text: Official manuals, guides and repositories reviewed October 27, 2026. Full source links and feature limits are in notes.

elements.name: takeaway text
elements.text: Good documentation lowers integration uncertainty; it does not establish bug-free operation.

Component / docs	What we can reuse	What remains to qualify
systemd + Docker	Service lifecycle, OCI API and build tooling	Cross-backend job ownership and actual stop
LiteLLM	Aliases, virtual keys, limits and routing	Postgres cost; OSS features; exact-model policy
Docling + Paper2Agent	Source parsing and MCP conversion recipe	Extraction quality and native host adaptation
pytest + Testcontainers	Test runner and disposable service fixtures	Fixed task criteria; trusted Docker access
BuildKit + ORAS	Image builds and OCI artifact transport	Bundle identities, admission and upgrades
restic / Quarto / MLflow	Backup, report rendering and run records	Consistent restore, evidence links and scope
